fields.description: Fallback policies used when not configured on the Shift Type.
fields.label: Default Policies

fields.description: Working days per month used to derive the daily rate from base salary (daily_rate = base / month_days). Common values: 22 (working days), 26 (six-day week), 30 (calendar days). Default is 30.
fields.label: Month Days

fields.description: Inputs for converting penalty minutes into a deduction amount. Used by the Factor penalty type and the daily-rate basis for the Penalty Matrix.
fields.label: Salary Calculation

fields.description: If checked Attendance Permissions will be created as auto processed, else will be pending.
fields.label: Auto Process Attendance Permission

fields.description: If checked Discipline Penalties will be created as auto processed, else will be pending.
fields.label: Auto Process Discipline Penalty

fields.description:
The Additional Salary
will be created as Draft if this field not checked.
fields.label: Auto Submit Additional Salary

fields.description: Notification sent to HR when an Attendance Permission is created with status Pending.
fields.label: Attendance Permission Pending

fields.description: Notification sent to HR when a Discipline Penalty is created with status Pending.
fields.label: Discipline Penalty Pending

fields.description:
Unchecked: every late/early event creates an Attendance Permission first; HR reviews and accepts before a penalty is generated.
Checked: penalties are processed directly from Attendance, skipping the HR review step. Use this when you trust the pipeline and want immediate enforcement.
fields.label: Split Permissions and Penalties

fields.description: Policy for penalizing minutes beyond an existing Attendance Permission (Factor or Fixed Per Hour only).
fields.label: Extra Minutes Penalty Policy

fields.description: If checked, manually created Attendance Permissions will also generate a Discipline Penalty. When unchecked, only auto-created permissions trigger penalties.
fields.label: Penalize Manual Attendance Permissions

fields.description: Base: daily rate = base / month days. Total: daily rate = (base + variable) / month days.
fields.label: Salary Basis
